pull_request.title: Tracker: configure Gen3 portal material mapping and validation
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping
pull_request.body:
Configure the Gen3 Tracker material-map prototype with one portal per signed sensitive layer: pixel barrel after the sensor, every other layer before, plus beam pipe, gap cylinders, barrel/endcap separators and outer shells. The native geometry gives **65 unique portals (15 cylinders, 50 discs), 8,550 bins**. All phi/z/r counts are configurable; phi defaults to one. A shared pixel/gap portal resolves its 250/500 requests to 500 bins and records both roles.

SoftEng added isolated native `ProtoSurfaceMaterial` support and runnable `nodd_material_mapping.py` / `nodd_material_validation.py` steering. The complete 100k Geant4 recording is mapped once, including silicon and beam pipe, with native slabs cleared in this mapping geometry. A native adapter shifts recorded pre-step positions to physical midpoints. The saved map reloads with exact portal IDs, material keys and grids.

**Observed result:** all **100,000 tracks / 17,137,021 steps** mapped, zero unmapped material, exact per-ray budget/count closure. A new **100,000-ray** validation sample gives mean differences of **+0.507% X₀ / +0.283% λI**; maximum η-bin differences are **1.10% / 0.83%**. Only the validation total overlays the original unrooted Geant4 component stack. With one phi bin, azimuthal differences reach **84.9% / 46.5%**; those plots are retained explicitly.

Expert-review follow-up: [cumulative Geant4/ACTS material comparisons](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/README.md) now show accumulated X₀ and λI versus barrel r for |η|<0.5, forward |z| in six intervals, and distance from the origin in all nine |η| intervals. Geant4 partial physical steps are integrated; ACTS budgets remain at thin portals. Both existing 100k-ray samples are normalized per ray, including zeros, with statistical SEM. Final totals are unchanged, while the forward cumulative difference reaches 0.363 X₀ near |z|=1.33 m for 1.5≤|η|<2.0. These are diagnostic differences without acceptance thresholds. [Slices and checkpoints are configurable](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/software/analysis/gen3_material_mapping/cumulative_config.json).

- [Trial report, overlays and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/README.md)
- [Configurable bin counts](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/software/analysis/gen3_material_mapping/mapping_config.json), [exact portal selection](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/selection.json)
- [Native build/run guide](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/software/source/ActsExamples/MaterialMapping/README.md)
- [Initial material/portal scatter and remote-material survey](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-mapping/README.md), retained as a separate control
- Governing prototype: DES-025 / ADR-008

Independent PhysVal at `2fff94bf5df903cff5cb8404754357ba318e71ef` reproduced all per-ray conservation and profile checks and every validation material-bin lookup, with no blocking identity/binning/normalization defect. It measured an important locality limit: **56.6% of X₀ is assigned more than 50 mm from its midpoint** (maximum displacement 413.3 mm). The report retains the full threshold table. Validation generation uses CLI flags; the configuration's validation block documents the intended run.

Validation: 36 portable controls (including seven cumulative-material controls); six native rejection/atomicity checks; native 1×1 mapping/validation smoke; exact full-map reload; retained-map/source-hash audit; PNG/PDF/SVG/CSV replay. CI reproduces portable checks and plots. Native execution uses the explicitly identified existing local ACTS/DD4hep build, with source/library/map hashes retained.

Before/after specifies carrier placement relative to a layer; current ACTS assignment uses the nearest finite selected intersection. Material order, distant-service locality, bin-occupancy uncertainty and tracking performance are not certified. Original recording geometry revision/seed remain unknown. **PROTOTYPE/DRAFT**, with no human sign-off or production geometry change.

Discussion and exact completed-turn usage remain in PR100’s interaction ledger and paired session records. The active parent turn is excluded until finalized.

comments.body:
Added the accumulated-material comparisons requested in [your comment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/100#issuecomment-6415806657):

- **Barrel r, |η|<0.5:** [X₀ and λI](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/figures/cumulative_r.png).
- **Forward |z|, six |η| intervals from 1.5 to 4.5:** [X₀](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/figures/cumulative_abs_z_X0.png), [λI](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/figures/cumulative_abs_z_L0.png).
- **d=√(r²+z²), all nine |η| intervals from 0 to 4.5:** [X₀](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/figures/cumulative_d_X0.png), [λI](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/figures/cumulative_d_L0.png).

The [report](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/tracker-gen3-material-mapping/docs/validation/gen3-material-map-run/cumulative/README.md) includes PDFs/compressed SVGs, the full profile data, sample counts and a 32-case comparison table. All slices/checkpoint settings are configurable.

The plots reuse all 100,000 Geant4 rays and 100,000 ACTS validation rays. Geant4 steps accumulate fractionally between physical pre/post positions; ACTS budgets jump at their recorded portals. Means and statistical SEM are computed per ray within each slice, including zeros, rather than treating steps as independent observations.

These curves expose intermediate spatial differences despite close final totals: the largest sampled forward difference is **0.36268 X₀ at |z|=1330 mm for 1.5≤|η|<2**, about 15% of that slice's final Geant4 budget. This is retained as a diagnostic discrepancy, without an accuracy acceptance claim.

All 36 portable controls pass. A separate PhysVal assessment at `bffaba61f2d243ac2025de2476b34411437798fa` independently reproduced representative ROOT checkpoints, all slice endpoints, uncertainties and the CSV comparisons, with no blocking findings.
Good enough at the time being.

events.text:
**GEN3RUN-PhysVal-01 — independent read-only review complete**

Reviewed **`2fff94bf5df903cff5cb8404754357ba318e71ef`**. No files changed or native physics rerun. No blocking defect found in retained material conservation, portal identity, binning or profile normalization.

**Findings**

- **Material locality remains a significant limitation.** I independently reduced `mapped.root/sur_distance`, which the pinned ACTS writer defines as midpoint-to-assigned-intersection distance. Of the mapped inventory:
  
  | Assignment distance | Steps | X₀ fraction | λI fraction |
  |---|---:|---:|---:|
  | >10 mm | 6,732,954 | 80.2647% | 65.7231% |
  | >50 mm | 400,757 | 56.6015% | 39.6059% |
  | >100 mm | 133,137 | 37.6793% | 26.5982% |

  Maximum distance is **413.289 mm**. These are diagnostic thresholds, not acceptance criteria. Thus zero unmapped material does not establish local representation. Retaining these measurements would make the originally requested remote-material flags specific to the selected 65 carriers.

- **P3 — validation configuration is currently descriptive.** `mapping_config.json:29–30` contains validation generation defaults, and the report says the configuration sets them. However, `nodd_material_validation.py:47–62` uses separate hardcoded CLI defaults; it never reads `manifest["configuration"]["validation"]`. Editing that JSON object does not alter generation. The recorded campaign is unaffected because its explicit CLI arguments match those values. Clarify the documentation or implement configuration defaults with explicit CLI precedence.

- **Before/after semantics are accurately disclosed.** `select_surfaces.py:64–102` selects the requested carrier side. Pinned ACTS `MaterialInteractionAssignment.cpp` explicitly performs nearest-intersection matching without pre/post matching. The trial therefore does not guarantee material ordering relative to sensitive crossings.

**Checks actually performed**

- Regenerated selection in memory from pinned source/configuration: **52 sensitive-layer roles + 14 extras → 65 portals**, 15 cylinders, 50 discs, 8,550 bins. The shared pixel/gap portal correctly retains both 250/500 requests and resolves to 500.
- Independently parsed the compressed map: exact 65 keys/IDs, requested axes/grids, no unkeyed surface or volume material, **1,672 zero slabs**.
- Verified original, mapped, unmapped and validation ROOT SHA-256 hashes against retained reports.
- Recomputed **all 100,000 ray identities and 17,137,021 steps** from original/mapped/unmapped ROOT files. Step partition and per-ray X₀/λI residuals are **exactly zero**.
- Checked the first event’s **100 tracks / 16,977 steps**: mapped positions follow the midpoint correction; material lengths/scales remain identical. Maximum position difference from float32 output rounding: **0.000122 mm**.
- Independently reproduced all validation profiles, counts, SEM and relative comparisons. Maximum η differences reproduce: **1.10036% X₀**, **0.82810% λI**. Maximum φ differences: **84.89495%**, **46.49846%**.
- Reproduced ACTS float32 bin arithmetic for **all 1,417,441 validation interactions**: every recorded X₀/λI material scale matches its serialized map bin. Ideal double-precision lookup initially disagreed at boundary cases; matching pinned ACTS arithmetic resolved those differences.
- Eight pinned selection/profile tests and direct homogeneous-1×1/multibin-rejection controls passed.
- Reversed the retained source patch in memory and verified both authoritative full-run source hashes. Baseline/final sidecar hashes also match the relocation record.
- Visually inspected the exact pinned η, φ and selected-portal PNGs: readable, correctly labelled, and validation appears only as a total.

**Limits**

The recording’s geometry revision and seed remain unknown. Phi=1 removes real azimuthal structure. Statistical bands exclude map-training uncertainty and geometry systematics; combined-SEM pulls are descriptive, not an acceptance test. Zero-thickness slabs do not distinguish unsampled bins from sampled vacuum. No material-order, displaced-origin, curved-track or reconstruction-performance validation was established.

The Spack preflight retained its existing fingerprint/source warnings; no fresh DD4hep/Geant4 execution is claimed. This assessment grants no design sign-off or production acceptance.

CUMULATIVE-PhysVal-01 reviewed **`bffaba61f2d243ac2025de2476b34411437798fa`** independently. **No blocking findings.** The five figures address all three observables requested in [noemina’s comment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/100#issuecomment-6415806657). This is a technical assessment, without human acceptance.

The scientific definitions are consistent:

- Geant4 material is integrated fractionally between physical pre/post coordinates; ACTS material remains a thin jump at each recorded interaction. Existing path budgets receive no second incidence correction. Evidence: `cumulative_profiles.py:126–175`.
- Contributions accumulate within each ray before means and SEM are computed. All rays contribute to normalization, including zero prefixes; the tests also cover completely empty rays. Eta folding and the final inclusive boundary match the documentation. Evidence: `cumulative_profiles.py:18–24,65–70,171–179`.
- Figures hold checkpoint values forward, preserving the thin-interaction convention within the stated 2/5 mm resolution. All five retained PNGs are readable, with correct labels, counts and endpoint plateaus. For these retained data, the last displayed interval equals the final checkpoint, so excluding that final checkpoint from histogram values loses no visible endpoint budget. Evidence: `plot_cumulative.py:130–150`.

Checks actually run:

- Read all seven pinned inputs using `git show`; verified working bytes and all five PNGs match the assigned revision. Concurrent dirty files were confined to accounting/session records and were excluded from scientific evidence.
- **36 portable tests passed**, including the seven cumulative controls.
- Retained-profile source/count/monotonicity/endpoint audit passed.
- Independently read both ROOT files, verified their complete SHA-256 values, and recomputed using direct segment fractions and per-ray sums, independently of the exporter’s difference-array algorithm. Per sample, **38 representative checkpoint quantity comparisons and 18 all-slice endpoint comparisons** matched retained means within **2.89×10⁻¹⁵** and SEM² within **8.15×10⁻¹⁹**.
- Independently checked all **32 CSV comparisons**; their numerical fields match the retained profiles exactly.
- Confirmed 100,000 rays per sample, 17,137,021 Geant4 steps and 1,417,441 ACTS interactions. Actual origins are zero; maximum off-ray position residuals are below **0.000171 mm**, within the declared precision check.

The interpretation remains appropriately bounded in `cumulative/README.md:101–119`. Close final totals coexist with substantial intermediate differences: **0.36268 X₀ at |z|=1330 mm for 1.5≤|η|<2**, approximately 15% of that slice’s final Geant4 budget. These are descriptive discrepancies rather than a unique diagnosis or acceptance threshold.

Remaining limits are the fixed-map statistical SEM, omitted map-training/systematic uncertainty, correlated checkpoints, differing within-slice ray mixtures, one phi bin, unknown original recording geometry revision/seed, and restriction to origin straight rays. No native physics rerun or rebuild was performed, and no files were changed.
